name: Industrial Ultra Strong Double Sided Acrylic Foam Mounting Tape (VHB Type)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 1.1mm closed-cell viscoelastic acrylic foam structural mounting tape, replacing rivets, screws, and spot welds for extreme exterior bonding.
overview: This industrial-grade double-sided acrylic foam tape utilizes high-strength viscoelastic closed-cell foam technology (comparable to 3M VHB series) to form permanent, indestructible structural bonds between dissimilar materials. Unlike mechanical fasteners like rivets, bolts, and spot welds that concentrate stress at single points and puncture surfaces, this tape distributes stress loads evenly across the entire bonded joint. The 100% closed-cell acrylic polymer absorbs dynamic vibrations, seals out moisture, and resists thermal expansion mismatches between metal, glass, composite, and rigid plastics.
keyFeatures: Replaces mechanical rivets, screws, spot welds, and liquid adhesives in structural bonding
1.1mm 100% closed-cell viscoelastic acrylic foam creates an impenetrable weather seal
Absorbs shock, dampens vibration, and accommodates thermal expansion differences
Dynamic shear strength exceeding 600 kPa with tremendous permanent holding power
Outstanding resistance to UV radiation, moisture, plasticizers, solvents, and salt spray
Temperature resilience spanning from -35°C up to +150°C short-term heat peaks
Eliminates drilling, hole punching, welding distortion, and post-weld grinding
applications: Commercial vehicle and bus body external panel skin bonding
Architectural metal cladding, ACP sheet stiffener bar attachment
High-rise exterior illuminated signage and channel letter mounting
Electronic equipment display faceplates and solar panel frame assembly
